title: EventBus multi-cycle failure selective recovery contract

contract.multi_cycle_continuity: EventBus remains operational across repeated broadcast cycles containing a failing listener
contract.callback_failure_isolation: A listener callback failure does not abort or poison subsequent EventBus.emit() cycles
contract.selective_recovery: The failing listener owner can be selectively unregistered and registered again between broadcast cycles
contract.duplicate_idempotency: Repeated registration during recovery does not create duplicate listener entries
contract.delivery_continuity: All currently registered listeners receive each emitted event exactly once
contract.registry_stability: Repeated failure and recovery cycles preserve a structurally valid listener registry
contract.source_metadata: Delivered events preserve the plugin_id supplied to emit() as source metadata
contract.emit_continuity: EventBus.emit() remains successful throughout all observed recovery cycles
contract.permission_enforcement: Registration, unregister, re-registration, and emit operations require the events permission
